text:
Hannah Pryce has invited the Customer Insights Team to a planning day on Friday 7 November, 9:30am to 4pm, at the Boathouse Room, Lakeside Community Centre, 12 Shore Road, Canberra (about ten minutes from the office, with free parking and the number 56 bus).

The morning will review the year: what worked, what didn't, and feedback on our reports. The afternoon will set no more than five priorities for next year, each with a named lead.

Before the day, each person should spend about 30 minutes noting their two proudest pieces of work, one thing to stop doing, and one idea for next year. Bring these along.

Lunch and morning tea are provided. Dietary requirements should go to Tariq by 31 October. Optional drinks at the pub across the road from about 4:15pm.

Set your out-of-office, and direct urgent requests to the central insights inbox, which Ella from the Data team is covering.
